name: Transverse-Field Ising Model Benchmark
description: Benchmark for quantum simulation of the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM), a paradigmatic model for studying quantum phase transitions. Implementations range from VQE ground-state calculations on NISQ hardware (tested on IQM Garnet, IBM Quantum) to Hamiltonian simulation of dynamics on trapped-ion platforms. Studies cover 1D chains up to 25 qubits and 2D lattices up to 6x6 sites.
hardware: IBM Quantum, IQM Garnet, Quantinuum, simulators
significance: The paradigmatic model for quantum phase transitions, serving as the primary test bed for quantum simulation capabilities across competing hardware platforms.

sources.title: A near-term quantum simulation of the transverse field Ising model hints at Glassy Dynamics
